name: Grok Bot Tutorial (plan2030)
tagline: Small task-first lessons that teach you the tool, in Korean and English at once.
description: You learn by finishing things rather than reading about features. Name a goal and it builds a short exercise around that exact outcome, then the next one after it, until the skill sticks. Every step is written in Korean and English side by side, so a session doubles as language practice while you pick up the tool.
author: plan2030
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
